[Section] Evaluation ::: Baselines
[source_id=61] We compare against four dialogue system baselines: Kvmemnn, Feed Yourself, Poly-encoder, and a BERT bi-ranker baseline trained on the Persona-Chat dataset using the same training hyperparameters (including learning rate scheduler and length capping settings) described in Section SECREF20. For the first three models, we use the provided pretrained (on Persona-Chat) models. We evaluate all four on our five evaluation characters discussed in Section SECREF28.
